mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM RESERVATION R WHERE TRUNC(R.CHECKIN) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND R.STATUS = '예약확정' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS WHERE CS.RESERVATION_ID = R.ID) ) AS TODAY_CHECKIN_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS JOIN RESERVATION R ON CS.RESERVATION_ID = R.ID WHERE TRUNC(R.CHECKOUT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND CS.CHECKOUT IS NULL ) AS TODAY_CHECKOUT_COUNT, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = '투숙중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 1) END FROM ROOM) AS OCCUPANCY_RATE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '청소중') AS ROOMS_NEED_CLEANING, (SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) FROM RESERVATION WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS TODAY_REVENUE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '이용가능') AS ROOM_AVAILABLE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '투숙중') AS ROOM_OCCUPIED, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '청소중') AS ROOM_CLEANING, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ROOM WHERE STATUS = '점검중') AS ROOM_INSPECTION, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '청소대기') AS HK_WAITING, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '청소중') AS HK_IN_PROGRESS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HOUSEKEEPING WHERE STATUS = '점검완료') AS HK_INSPECTED FROM DUAL

SELECT C.NAME AS guestName, RT.NAME AS roomTypeName, R.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, RES.CHECKIN AS checkinTime, RES.CODE AS reservationCode, RES.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, R.STATUS AS roomStatus FROM RESERVATION RES JOIN CUSTOMER C ON RES.GUEST_ID = C.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON RES.ROOM_TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN ROOM R ON RES.ROOM_ID = R.ID WHERE TRUNC(RES.CHECKIN) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND RES.STATUS = '예약확정' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS WHERE CS.RESERVATION_ID = RES.ID) ORDER BY RES.CHECKIN ASC
